title.en: NYC Marathon 2027 entry: men's marathon time-qualifier standards (age on 7 Nov 2027)

unit.en: finish time in minutes (net chip time)

note.zh-CN: 数值照录 NYRR 官方 2027 名额男子马拉松标准；资格窗口 2026-01-01 至 2026-12-31，按净计时评估；女子与非二元标准见正文表格。非 NYRR 赛事只接受认证全马成绩，半马成绩不计入 Non-NYRR 名额。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Values transcribed from the official NYRR 2027 entry men's marathon standards; qualifying window 1 Jan – 31 Dec 2026, evaluated on net chip time; women's and nonbinary standards are in the body table. Non-NYRR entries accept certified full marathons only; half-marathon times do not count. Site-made chart, not an official course profile.
